stem: 金融情报机构(FIU)作为国家中心,负责接收和分析可疑活动报告(SAR),并可从其他报告实体获取与以下方面相关的更多信息:

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 各辖区应设立金融情报机构以分析可疑交易报告并支持执法调查
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Establishment of FIU for analyzing STRs
candidate_pool.en_quote: Jurisdictions should establish an FIU to analyze suspicious transaction reports and support law enforcement investigations.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融机构有义务向金融情报机构报告可疑交易
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Obligation to report suspicious transactions to FIU
candidate_pool.en_quote: Recommendations 20 to 23 discuss the obligation to report suspicious transactions. Financial institutions should report suspicious transactions to the relevant Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: FIU从报告实体、国内来源及其他国家FIU获取信息
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Sources of FIU information
candidate_pool.en_quote: FIUs obtain SARs and other information from reporting entities and a range of other domestic sources. FIUs have access to other FIUs internationally.
heading_context: Law enforcement and FIU AFC cooperation

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融情报中心分析可疑交易报告并与执法机构共享信息。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FIU analysis and information sharing
candidate_pool.en_quote: As an agency under the Commission, the FIU analyzes suspicious transaction reports and shares information with law enforcement agencies.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 一些金融机构设有专门团队处理情报分析或可疑活动报告等不同方面。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FI teams may handle different intelligence aspects
candidate_pool.en_quote: Some FIs might have teams that deliver different aspects of the requested intelligence, such as intelligence analysis or suspicious activity reports (SAR).
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 联合财富情报组是香港的金融情报机构，负责收集、分析可疑交易报告并转交执法机构
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Joint Financial Intelligence Unit as FIU
candidate_pool.en_quote: Additionally, the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit is a regulator that collects suspicious transaction reports, analyzes them, and refers the criminal intelligence to law enforcement agencies and authorities for further investigation and prosecution. It is the FIU of Hong Kong.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 向金融情报机构提交可疑活动报告
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: SAR filing: Report suspicious activities to the appropriate FIU
candidate_pool.en_quote: SAR filing: Report suspicious activities to the appropriate FIU.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 国家金融情报机构接收、分析和传播金融情报
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Core functions of national FIUs
candidate_pool.en_quote: National FIUs receive, analyze, and disseminate financial intelligence.
heading_context: Roles of regulators, law enforcement, and FIUs

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 信息共享使金融情报机构能够共享可疑金融活动的情报
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Information sharing, which enables FIUs to share intelligence on suspicious financial activities
candidate_pool.en_quote: Information sharing, which enables FIUs to share intelligence on suspicious financial activities.
heading_context: AFC guidance from leading international organizations

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融公司提交可疑交易报告后，金融情报院可将相关信息分享给执法机构以采取进一步行动。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Post-report information sharing with law enforcement
candidate_pool.en_quote: After financial companies file reports of suspicious transactions, the FIU may share relevant information with law enforcement for further action.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 英国金融情报机构（UKFIU）接收、分析并分发可疑活动报告（SARs）情报
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: The UKFIU operates independently within the National Economic Crime Command (NECC) as an integral part of the National Crime Agency (NCA). It receives, analyzes, and disseminates intelligence submitted through SARs to share with law enforcement agencies. The NCA has the power of arrest and can seek warrants and court orders. Additionally, it can freeze and confiscate assets it suspects are involved in money laundering, terrorism financing, or other criminal activities
candidate_pool.en_quote: The UKFIU operates independently within the National Economic Crime Command (NECC) as an integral part of the National Crime Agency (NCA). It receives, analyzes, and disseminates intelligence submitted through SARs to share with law enforcement agencies. The NCA has the power of arrest and can seek warrants and court orders. Additionally, it can freeze and confiscate assets it suspects are involved in money laundering, terrorism financing, or other criminal activities.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融机构有义务回应FIU和执法机构关于交易和账户所有权的信息请求。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FI obligation to respond to FIU and law enforcement requests
candidate_pool.en_quote: Financial institutions (FI) are routinely required to respond to requests from FIUs and law enforcement for more information on transactions and account ownership.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 洗钱RO监督机构反洗钱项目，向FIU提交可疑活动报告，确保反洗钱策略与政策的实施与合规。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: MLRO responsibilities overview
candidate_pool.en_quote: An MLRO oversees an organization’s AML program, files SARs to the relevant FIU, and ensures implementation and compliance with AML strategies and policies.
heading_context: Role of money laundering reporting officer

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融情报机构综合银行可疑交易报告与跨境金融活动，触发国际监管网络红旗信号信号
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FIU synthesis of SARs and cross-border activity
candidate_pool.en_quote: FIUs synthesized bank SARs with cross-border financial activity, triggering red flags within international regulatory networks.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 可疑交易报告办公室（STRO）是新加坡的金融情报机构，隶属于新加坡警察部队，负责接收和分析金融情报。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: STRO as FIU and its role
candidate_pool.en_quote: The Suspicious Transaction Reporting Office (STRO) is the FIU of the jurisdiction. STRO is part of the Singapore Police Force and responsible for receiving and analyzing financial intelligence.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 可疑交易报告（SAR）是义务主体在发现可疑或潜在非法活动时必须向金融情报机构（FIU）提交的文件
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Definition of SAR
candidate_pool.en_quote: A SAR is a document that obliged parties must file with their FIU when they detect suspicious or potentially illicit activity.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 洗钱报告官（MLRO）根据调查结果向金融情报机构（FIU）提交可疑交易报告（SAR）
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: MLRO files SAR with FIU based on investigation
candidate_pool.en_quote: Based on the investigative results, the MLRO might file a SAR with the country’s FIU, so law enforcement can gain access to the information.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 战略情报/分析报告对金融犯罪类型或趋势进行广泛审视，综合多源信息
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Definition of strategic intelligence/analysis reports
candidate_pool.en_quote: Some governments, national FIUs, and law enforcement authorities also produce strategic intelligence or strategic analysis reports. These reports take a broad view of a financial crime type or trend, drawing on multiple sources to provide an understanding of threats.
heading_context: Using the reports and guidance from different authorities
Using AFC reports, guidance notes, and policy papers

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 复杂案件和警报升级至第二道防线金融情报单位（FIU）进一步调查
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Escalation of complex cases to second line FIU
candidate_pool.en_quote: Teams often escalate complex cases and alerts that cannot be ruled out to the second line’s financial intelligence unit (FIU) for further investigation.
heading_context: First line of defense AFC function

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 银行有义务调查并及时向金融情报机构报告与洗钱或恐怖融资相关的可疑交易。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Bank obligation to report suspicious transactions to FIU
candidate_pool.en_quote: Banks are required to investigate and promptly report suspicious transactions linked to money laundering or terrorist financing to the FIU.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Case study: Failure to file report

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 国家FIU根据操作分析向执法部门传播情报包
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FIUs disseminate intelligence to law enforcement
candidate_pool.en_quote: National FIUs disseminate intelligence packages to law enforcement based on their operational analysis.
heading_context: Law enforcement and FIU AFC cooperation

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融行动特别工作组建议20要求金融机构在有合理理由怀疑资金来自犯罪活动或与恐怖融资有关时进行调查和报告。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FATF Recommendation 20 obligation to investigate and report suspicious transactions
candidate_pool.en_quote: Under FATF Recommendation 20, financial institutions (FI) must investigate and report any suspicious transactions when there are reasonable grounds to suspect the funds are proceeds of criminal activity or linked to terrorist financing.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Case study: Failure to file report

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR最重要的目的是协助执法和分析人员收集潜在非法活动的信息和情报
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Purpose of SARs
candidate_pool.en_quote: The most important purpose of SARs is to assist law enforcement and analysts in collecting information and intelligence on potential illegal activity.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 提交可疑活动报告前可能需要进一步调查以获取更多信息。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Need for further research before SAR filing
candidate_pool.en_quote: Before deciding to file a SAR, the organization might need to conduct further research to obtain additional information. This need becomes evident during the SAR review process.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法和情报界利用SAR报告应对非法活动并收集情报以预防未来事件
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Law enforcement and intelligence use SARs
candidate_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement and the intelligence community use these reports to respond to illicit activity and gather intelligence useful in preventing future occurences.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 无法缓解风险指标时，需升级客户调查，可能提交可疑活动报告。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Escalation process for unresolved risk indicators
candidate_pool.en_quote: If investigators have completed the research and identified risk indicators that cannot be mitigated, they might need to escalate this customer for additional investigation. Depending on the jurisdiction and organizational policies, the end result might be filing a SAR to the FIU. Based on the organization's processes, one or more additional people might review the research before choosing whether to file a report with authorities.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融犯罪防控报告解释金融犯罪防控制度的运作，例如FIU年度报告包含统计和案例研究
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: AFC reports explain regime operation and include examples from FIUs
candidate_pool.en_quote: AFC reports explain how the AFC regime, or parts of it, operates. For example, national FIUs often produce annual reports that include statistics and other information, such as case studies on the level and nature of reporting from different sectors.
heading_context: Using the reports and guidance from different authorities
Using AFC reports, guidance notes, and policy papers

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 《反洗钱法》将可疑交易报告转变为高价值情报工具
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: AML Act transforms SARs into intelligence tool with high usefulness
candidate_pool.en_quote: Another goal of the AML Act is to transform SARs from a simple reporting requirement to a tool for intelligence gathering. SARs are now expected to provide a “high degree of usefulness” for law enforcement and national security agencies.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 本模块介绍如何通过准备清晰全面的可疑活动报告以及与金融情报机构和执法机构沟通来结束调查。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Module learning objectives
candidate_pool.en_quote: In this module, you will learn how to finalize investigations by preparing clear, comprehensive SARs and understanding the nuances in communicating with the FIU and law enforcement agencies.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Introduction: Concluding investigations and coordinating with law enforcement

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 案例：Isabella向高级管理层报告趋势，准备并提交可疑活动报告，并向工作组反馈
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Isabella's actions in response to typology report
candidate_pool.en_quote: Isabella reports this trend to senior management, then prepares and files SARs, ensuring that the FIU knows these reports are being submitted because of the public-private partnership. She also reports her findings to the working group and confirms that their typology appears to be sound.
heading_context: Case example: Using typology reports to enhance AML controls

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 指定官员必须与法律团队、记录保存等部门建立有效关系以确保透明度和问责制并缩短响应时间
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Designated officer must develop relationships to ensure transparency and accountability
candidate_pool.en_quote: Additionally, the designated officer must develop effective relationships with legal teams, recordkeeping, and other departments likely to be involved in responding to a law enforcement agency's request. These relationships ensure transparency and accountability and decrease the FI’s response time.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 操作分析为执法部门提供可用于调查洗钱、恐怖融资和上游犯罪的情报
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Operational analysis leads to intelligence and disruptions
candidate_pool.en_quote: Operational analysis provides law enforcement with intelligence it can use for investigations into money laundering, terrorist financing, and predicate offenses. The intelligence can ultimately lead to disruptions, including arrests, prosecutions, convictions, and asset recovery.
heading_context: Law enforcement and FIU AFC cooperation

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法部门通过SAR识别非法活动内容、地点、时间、使用的产品以及被认定为可疑的原因
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: How law enforcement uses SARs
candidate_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement will look at these reports to identify what the illicit activity was, where and when it occurred, what products were used to facilitate the activity, and—most importantly—why it is considered suspicious.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法机构成立工作组，包括金融情报机构、监管机构及银行和虚拟资产行业代表
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Law enforcement working group to address trend
candidate_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement sets up a working group to address this trend. The group includes the FIU, regulator, and representatives of the bank and virtual assets sectors. The group's aim is to produce better intelligence to detect those involved in this activity and improve controls in the private sector.
heading_context: Case example: Using typology reports to enhance AML controls

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 基于活动模式（谁、什么、地点、时间、方式、原因），执法部门可能增加或提出相关犯罪和洗钱指控
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Using activity patterns to develop criminal charges
candidate_pool.en_quote: Based on the pattern of activity—who, what, where, when, how, and why—law enforcement might develop or add criminal charges for the underlying activity and possible money laundering.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 类型学描述特定金融犯罪实例如何运作，由FIU、执法机构等发布
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Definition of typologies
candidate_pool.en_quote: Typologies, which describe how particular instances of financial crime have operated, are produced by national FIUs, law enforcement bodies, and other government agencies.
heading_context: Using the reports and guidance from different authorities
Using AFC reports, guidance notes, and policy papers

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 报告可疑活动有助于遵守金融犯罪防控法规并提升金融机构的金融犯罪防控效果。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Benefits of reporting suspicious activity
candidate_pool.en_quote: Reporting suspicious activity helps maintain compliance with AFC regulations and enhances the effectiveness of a financial institution’s AFC efforts.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Introduction: Concluding investigations and coordinating with law enforcement

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 《金融交易报告法》保障韩国金融情报院的独立性和自主权，使其成为收集、分析和传播金融交易信息的主要机构。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Korea FIU independence and role under the Financial Transaction Reports Act
candidate_pool.en_quote: The Financial Transaction Reports Act guarantees independence and autonomy of the Korea FIU. According to this law, the FIU is the primary authority for collecting, analyzing, and disseminating financial transaction information.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 该法为金融公司向金融情报院报告可疑交易和高额现金交易提供了法律框架。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Reporting obligations for financial companies under the Act
candidate_pool.en_quote: This act provides a legal framework for financial companies to report suspicious transactions and high-value cash transactions to the FIU.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 该法要求金融机构通过识别和报告可疑交易及冻结资产来防止恐怖融资。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Obligations on financial institutions under the Act
candidate_pool.en_quote: Additionally, this act imposes obligations on financial institutions to prevent the financing of terrorism by identifying and reporting suspicious transactions and freezing assets.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法机构对Wolfe及其同伙进行针对性监控，追踪现金走私者和哈瓦拉网络
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Surveillance on Mr. Wolfe and associates
candidate_pool.en_quote: As FIUs escalated the case, law enforcement agencies, including Europol, Interpol, and national counterterrorism task forces, conducted targeted surveillance on Mr. Wolfe and his criminal associates. These individuals, designated as subjects of interest, were monitored to trace cash smugglers and hawala networks.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 可疑活动报告（SAR）是金融犯罪防控（金融犯罪防控）项目最重要的产品，执法部门是其主要客户
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: SAR as most important product of AFC program
candidate_pool.en_quote: If an AFC program were a factory, suspicious activity reports (SAR) would be its most important product and law enforcement would be its main customer.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR在启动新案件、增强现有调查和制定更广泛的金融情报活动监测方面具有不可估量的价值
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Value of SARs
candidate_pool.en_quote: These reports are invaluable in initiating new cases, enhancing ongoing investigations, and developing broader financial intelligence activity monitoring.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法部门访问相关数据库后可有效搜索姓名、标识符、数据、备案和主体实体以及关键叙述信息
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Searching SAR database
candidate_pool.en_quote: Once they access the relevant database, they can effectively search names, identifiers, data, filing and subject entities, and vital narrative information.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法部门可追踪资金和其他支持数据，确定其他涉案犯罪分子并扩大调查范围
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Following money and data to expand investigation
candidate_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement may be able to follow the money and other supporting data, determine other criminals involved in the activity, and expand the investigation further.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting
How law enforcement case investigators read a SAR

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 德国联邦金融监管局因德意志银行未及时提交可疑交易报告对其处以17万欧元罚款。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: BaFin fined Deutsche Bank for late STR submission
candidate_pool.en_quote: In March 2023, the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority of Germany (BaFin), fined Deutsche Bank AG €170,000 for failing to submit suspicious transaction reports (STR) on time. The administrative order was final and binding.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Case study: Failure to file report

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 及时提交可疑交易报告使当局能够迅速行动并向执法机构传递信息。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Timely STR submission enables quick action by authorities
candidate_pool.en_quote: The regulator emphasized that the timely submission of STRs allows authorities to act quickly and forward information to law enforcement agencies.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Case study: Failure to file report

candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Typology report content and student VASP account usage
candidate_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement issues a typology report via the group, explaining how the suspected money laundering happens. The report indicates that students open accounts with VASPs and move the proceeds of crime to and from these accounts via their local bank accounts.
heading_context: Case example: Using typology reports to enhance AML controls

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 案例：Isabella向高级内部委员会提交发现和建议，包括了解你的客户和客户风险参数调整
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Isabella presents findings and recommendations to senior committee
candidate_pool.en_quote: Isabella also presents the findings to a senior internal committee along with recommendations for better protecting the organization from this activity in the future. Her recommendations include changes to the KYC and client risk profile parameters as well as adjustments to transaction monitoring processes.
heading_context: Case example: Using typology reports to enhance AML controls

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 机构有义务协调活动以维护信息保密性和完整性并确保披露符合法律合规标准
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Coordination obligation for confidentiality and legal compliance
candidate_pool.en_quote: They should coordinate their activities strategically and tactically to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information and ensure all disclosures meet legal compliance standards.
heading_context: Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 该立法概述了反洗钱框架，并与其他打击金融犯罪的法律法规相结合，包括《有组织及严重罪行条例》等
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Framework and related laws
candidate_pool.en_quote: This legislation outlines the framework for AML and is coupled with other laws and regulations combating financial crimes. These laws and regulations include the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance, the Drug Trafficking Ordinance, the Theft Ordinance, the United Nations Ordinance, and the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: FIU开展操作分析供执法部门调查洗钱、恐怖融资和上游犯罪
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Purpose of operational analysis by FIUs
candidate_pool.en_quote: They also produce operational analysis that law enforcement uses to investigate and disrupt money laundering, terrorist financing, and predicate offenses.
heading_context: Roles of regulators, law enforcement, and FIUs

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 英国金融制裁执行办公室（OFSI）负责实施联合国和欧盟的金融制裁
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: The Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) is part of HM Treasury and is responsible for implementing UN and EU financia sanctions. candidate_pool.en_quote: The Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) is part of HM Treasury and is responsible for implementing UN and EU financia sanctions. candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 法律应保护金融机构及其员工免于责任并禁止披露可疑交易
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Laws should protect financial institutions and their employees from liability and prohibit them from disclosing suspicious transactions
candidate_pool.en_quote: Laws should protect financial institutions and their employees from liability and prohibit them from disclosing suspicious transactions.

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团强调在可疑交易报告流程中政府机构与金融机构需加强合作。
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Wolfsberg Group emphasizes collaboration in STR filing
candidate_pool.en_quote: The Wolfsberg Group’s highlights the need for closer collaboration between government agencies and financial institutions in the STR filing process. As financial crime typologies evolve, emerging technologies and new transaction methods create additional challenges, making strong cooperation more important than ever.
heading_context: Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement
Case study: Failure to file report

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 根据FATF标准和埃格蒙特集团原则，FIU应自发或应请求相互传播金融情报
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: FIU obligation to disseminate financial intelligence
candidate_pool.en_quote: Under FATF standards and principles set by the Egmont Group of FIUs, FIUs are expected to disseminate financial intelligence to each other, either spontaneously or on request.
heading_context: Law enforcement and FIU AFC cooperation

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: FIU可将跨境数据纳入操作分析并传播给执法部门采取行动
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Use of disseminated data by FIUs

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 调查人员对信息进行筛选、组织和优先级排序。
context_pool.en_quote: Investigators filtered, organized, and prioritized.

context_pool.en_quote: They relied on all of those sources and adequately documented the case.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 在可疑活动上报中，使用精确语言至关重要

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 必须使用机构规定的正确报告名称

context_pool.en_quote: Don’t be casual in referring to something as "unusual" or "suspicious", especially when documenting.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 部分司法管辖区对可疑交易报告（SAR）提交有时间要求
context_pool.en_quote: Some jurisdictions have timing requirements for when a financial institution should file a SAR based on when it was determined to be suspicious.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 洗钱报告官（MLRO）根据调查结果向金融情报机构（FIU）提交可疑交易报告（SAR）
context_pool.en_quote: Based on the investigative results, the MLRO might file a SAR with the country’s FIU, so law enforcement can gain access to the information.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 创建审计线索，记录合规步骤及不准确或误匹配的解决过程
context_pool.en_quote: To demonstrate that an organization has undertaken appropriate research to prevent financial crime, it is important to create an audit trail. context_pool.knowledge_zh: 信息来源的可靠性比较：较旧来源通常可靠性较低
context_pool.en_quote: Some of this will be straightforward, as one source may be older and therefore less reliable than another source.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 按照机构记录保留政策，以PDF、打印件等形式保存文档
context_pool.en_quote: Save documentation as PDFs, printed out, or collected in some other manner according to the organization’s record retention policy.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 详尽的文档记录支持基于风险的方法，即使信息不全，过程本身也可辩护
context_pool.en_quote: Thorough documentation provides a record to support your organization’s risk-based approach. So, even if you fail to capture every relevant piece of information, the process itself is defensible.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 提交可疑交易报告（SAR）是金融犯罪防控（金融犯罪防控）计划的关键部分，也是打击洗钱和恐怖融资的重要环节
context_pool.en_quote: Filing SARs is a key part of an organization’s AFC program and a vital element in combating money laundering and terrorism financing.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 洗钱报告官（MLRO）或指定官员负责监督金融犯罪防控（金融犯罪防控）合规计划并最终决定是否提交可疑交易报告（SAR）

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 提交可疑活动报告前可能需要进一步调查以获取更多信息。
context_pool.en_quote: Before deciding to file a SAR, the organization might need to conduct further research to obtain additional information. This need becomes evident during the SAR review process.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 反洗钱报告负责人审查可疑活动报告并提出问题以确保叙述完整有力。
context_pool.en_quote: The MLRO, or designated secondary reviewer, reads the SAR and might raise questions for the investigator. This ensures the SAR narrative is cohesive and sufficiently robust.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 反洗钱报告负责人和调查团队应制定允许反馈和补充调查的内部时间表。
context_pool.en_quote: Therefore, MLROs and investigation teams should create internal investigation and review timelines that allow for feedback and additional research.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 各司法管辖区对提交报告有报告规则和截止日期。
context_pool.en_quote: Jurisdictions have reporting rules and deadlines for submitting reports.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 美国金融犯罪执法网络要求可疑活动报告在初始警报后30个日历日内提交。
context_pool.en_quote: For example, in the US, FinCEN requires SARs to be filed within 30 calendar days of the initial alert.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 结束调查并与执法部门协调是打击金融犯罪的关键任务。
context_pool.en_quote: Concluding investigations and liaising with law enforcement are critical tasks in combating financial crime.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 本模块介绍如何通过准备清晰全面的可疑活动报告以及与金融情报机构和执法机构沟通来结束调查。
context_pool.en_quote: In this module, you will learn how to finalize investigations by preparing clear, comprehensive SARs and understanding the nuances in communicating with the FIU and law enforcement agencies.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 报告可疑活动有助于遵守金融犯罪防控法规并提升金融机构的金融犯罪防控效果。
context_pool.en_quote: Reporting suspicious activity helps maintain compliance with AFC regulations and enhances the effectiveness of a financial institution’s AFC efforts.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 应用这些实践有助于组织成为检测、预防和打击金融犯罪的主动合作伙伴。
context_pool.en_quote: By applying these practices, you will help ensure that your organization becomes a proactive partner in detecting, preventing, and disrupting financial crimes.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 德国联邦金融监管局因德意志银行未及时提交可疑交易报告对其处以17万欧元罚款。

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 银行有义务调查并及时向金融情报机构报告与洗钱或恐怖融资相关的可疑交易。
context_pool.en_quote: Banks are required to investigate and promptly report suspicious transactions linked to money laundering or terrorist financing to the FIU.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 德国联邦金融监管局发现德意志银行延迟提交可疑交易报告，阻碍了执法部门检测和预防犯罪。
context_pool.en_quote: BaFin discovered that Deutsche Bank delayed filing STRs, which hindered law enforcement's ability to detect and prevent crime, prolonging illicit operations.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 及时提交可疑交易报告使当局能够迅速行动并向执法机构传递信息。
context_pool.en_quote: The regulator emphasized that the timely submission of STRs allows authorities to act quickly and forward information to law enforcement agencies.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 延迟提交可疑交易报告损害金融部门诚信，使犯罪分子得以利用时间差清洗非法资金。

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 德国联邦金融监管局对德意志银行的执法行动凸显了不合规的实际后果。
context_pool.en_quote: BaFin’s enforcement action against Deutsche Bank highlights the real-world consequences of noncompliance.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 及时报告既是合规要求，也是从源头预防金融犯罪的关键。
context_pool.en_quote: Timely reporting is a matter of compliance and is critical for preventing financial crime at its source.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融行动特别工作组建议20要求金融机构在有合理理由怀疑资金来自犯罪活动或与恐怖融资有关时进行调查和报告。
context_pool.en_quote: Under FATF Recommendation 20, financial institutions (FI) must investigate and report any suspicious transactions when there are reasonable grounds to suspect the funds are proceeds of criminal activity or linked to terrorist financing.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 善意报告不构成刑事责任。
context_pool.en_quote: This reporting is done in good faith and does not equate to criminal liability.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: FATF建议20解释性说明要求报告所有可疑交易，包括未遂交易，无论金额大小。
context_pool.en_quote: FATF’s Interpretive Note to Recommendation 20 specifies that all suspicious transactions, including attempted transactions, should be reported regardless of the transaction amount.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 沃尔夫斯堡集团强调在可疑交易报告流程中政府机构与金融机构需加强合作。
context_pool.en_quote: The Wolfsberg Group’s highlights the need for closer collaboration between government agencies and financial institutions in the STR filing process. context_pool.en_quote: Financial institutions (FI) are routinely required to respond to requests from FIUs and law enforcement for more information on transactions and account ownership.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法请求的类型包括法院传票、生产令和与调查相关的具体询问。
context_pool.en_quote: Such requests include court subpoenas, production orders, and specific inquiries related to new or ongoing investigations.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法机构可能要求金融机构保持账户开放并监控以协助调查。
context_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement might request that an FI keep a particular account open and monitor it for investigative purposes.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 这些请求要求高度保密性、紧迫性和准确性。
context_pool.en_quote: These requests demand high levels of confidentiality, urgency, and accuracy.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 适当的响应协议尤为重要。
context_pool.en_quote: Proper response protocols are particularly important:

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 收到执法请求后，金融机构应进行初步评估。
context_pool.en_quote: Upon receipt of a law enforcement request, the FI should make an initial assessment.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 初步评估通常由金融机构指定的合规团队官员进行。
context_pool.en_quote: The FI’s nominated or designated officer typically conducts this assessment. This officer is usually an employee from one of the compliance teams who has been specifically assigned to this task.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 初步评估的目的是理解请求的合法性、紧迫性和相关性。
context_pool.en_quote: The purpose of the assessment is to understand the legality, urgency, and relevance of the request.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融机构的响应必须相称且合理，符合法律义务和运营能力。
context_pool.en_quote: It is crucial to ensure the FI's response is proportionate and justifiable, aligning with both legal obligations and operational capabilities.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 一些金融机构设有专门团队处理情报分析或可疑活动报告等不同方面。
context_pool.en_quote: Some FIs might have teams that deliver different aspects of the requested intelligence, such as intelligence analysis or suspicious activity reports (SAR).

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 机构有义务协调活动以维护信息保密性和完整性并确保披露符合法律合规标准
context_pool.en_quote: They should coordinate their activities strategically and tactically to maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the information and ensure all disclosures meet legal compliance standards.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 指定官员必须与法律团队、记录保存等部门建立有效关系以确保透明度和问责制并缩短响应时间
context_pool.en_quote: Additionally, the designated officer must develop effective relationships with legal teams, recordkeeping, and other departments likely to be involved in responding to a law enforcement agency's request. context_pool.knowledge_zh: 处理复杂的执法请求可能需要机构多个部门的协调
context_pool.en_quote: This is especially the case when dealing with complex law enforcement requests that might require coordination from many facets of the organization.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 综合方法强调合规性和响应能力，同时维护客户数据的保密性和完整性
context_pool.en_quote: An integrated approach emphasizes both compliance and responsiveness while maintaining the confidentiality and integrity of customer data throughout the process.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 可疑活动报告（SAR）是金融犯罪防控（金融犯罪防控）项目最重要的产品，执法部门是其主要客户
context_pool.en_quote: If an AFC program were a factory, suspicious activity reports (SAR) would be its most important product and law enforcement would be its main customer.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR可用于启动调查或增强正在进行的调查
context_pool.en_quote: SARs can be used to initiate an investigation or enhance an ongoing investigation.

context_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement and the intelligence community use these reports to respond to illicit activity and gather intelligence useful in preventing future occurences.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR数据包含识别嫌疑人、网络、司法管辖区和非法资金流动的关键细节
context_pool.en_quote: SAR data contains critical details to identify suspects, networks, jurisdictions, and, most importantly, the movement of illicit funds.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR提供直接和间接获取洗钱及上游非法活动证据的丰富途径
context_pool.en_quote: SARs offer an abundance of direct and indirect access to evidence of money laundering and the illicit activity that fuels it.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR不能作为证据使用
context_pool.en_quote: However, SARs cannot be used as evidence.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR最重要的目的是协助执法和分析人员收集潜在非法活动的信息和情报
context_pool.en_quote: The most important purpose of SARs is to assist law enforcement and analysts in collecting information and intelligence on potential illegal activity.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: “跟着钱走”这句话在实践中经常被证明是正确的
context_pool.en_quote: The phrase “follow the money” routinely proves to be true.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR在启动新案件、增强现有调查和制定更广泛的金融情报活动监测方面具有不可估量的价值
context_pool.en_quote: These reports are invaluable in initiating new cases, enhancing ongoing investigations, and developing broader financial intelligence activity monitoring.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: SAR表格数据和叙述对于执法和分析人员在实地工作中至关重要
context_pool.en_quote: The SAR form data and narrative are critical for law enforcement and analysts to leverage in the field.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法部门访问相关数据库后可有效搜索姓名、标识符、数据、备案和主体实体以及关键叙述信息
context_pool.en_quote: Once they access the relevant database, they can effectively search names, identifiers, data, filing and subject entities, and vital narrative information.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法部门通过SAR识别非法活动内容、地点、时间、使用的产品以及被认定为可疑的原因
context_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement will look at these reports to identify what the illicit activity was, where and when it occurred, what products were used to facilitate the activity, and—most importantly—why it is considered suspicious.

context_pool.en_quote: They can also search a SAR database to see if a suspect is mentioned in other SARs, which institution filed, and where the illicit money might have gone.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 基于活动模式（谁、什么、地点、时间、方式、原因），执法部门可能增加或提出相关犯罪和洗钱指控
context_pool.en_quote: Based on the pattern of activity—who, what, where, when, how, and why—law enforcement might develop or add criminal charges for the underlying activity and possible money laundering.

context_pool.knowledge_zh: 执法部门可追踪资金和其他支持数据，确定其他涉案犯罪分子并扩大调查范围
context_pool.en_quote: Law enforcement may be able to follow the money and other supporting data, determine other criminals involved in the activity, and expand the investigation further.
